ja: ２０１５年５月店頭発売予定「ＭＧ １／１００ 百式 Ｖｅｒ．２．０」連動アイテム
※ 当商品に、「ＭＧ １／１００ 百式 Ｖｅｒ．２．０」は付属しません。
百式の代表的な武器“メガ・バズーカ・ランチャー”、１/１００スケールで初キット化！！
『機動戦士Ｚガンダム』より、百式の特徴的な武装「メガ・バズーカ・ランチャー」をＭＧシリーズで商品化。
１／１００スケールマスターグレード準拠のディテールで立体化し、印象深い劇中シーンを再現可能。
２０１５年５月店頭発売予定の、「ＭＧ １／１００ 百式 Ｖｅｒ．２．０」（別売）に対応。
●　伸縮・展開ギミックを搭載し、射撃形態／収納形態に変形可能！
（射撃形態）
劇中での百式の特徴的な武装‘メガ・バズーカ・ランチャー’の印象的な射撃シーンを再現可能。
全長約２７５ｍｍ（※射撃形態時）。
砲身とステップアームが伸び、手をかける左右の装甲が展開され、百式本体に固定が可能。
（収納形態）
収納形態への変形ギミック搭載。高速移動シーンが再現可能。
※ 高速移動シーンの再現には、アクションベース1が２個必要です。
※ 組み合わせ例写真で使用している、アクションベース１（クリア）は別売です。
・ センサー部分はジュエルシールでリアルに再現。
・ 動力ケーブルは、ボールジョイントの連結で再現。メガ・バズーカ・ランチャー本体の伸縮に柔軟に対応。
●　ブラックスモーククリアのアクションベース１が付属！
大型のメガ・バズーカ・ランチャーを安定してディスプレイできる専用ジョイントパーツが付属。
メガ・バズーカ・ランチャー単体でのディスプレイも可能。
●　水転写デーカール付属！
メガ・バズーカ・ランチャーに加え、「ＭＧ １／１００ 百式 Ｖｅｒ．２．０」（別売）本体に対応するマーキングデザインを収録。
※ 本体用マーキングは、本体商品側に収録されているものと同じデザインです。

en: 20155 Store Release Scheduled "MG 1/100 Hyakushiki Ver.2.0" linked item
* "MG 1/100 Hyakushiki Ver. 2.0" is not included with this product.
Hyakushiki's signature weapon "Mega Bazooka Launcher" is now available as a 1/100 scale kit for the first time! !
From "Mobile Suit Z Gundam", Hyaku-shiki's distinctive weapon "Mega Bazooka Launcher" is commercialized in the MG series.
It is three-dimensionalized with details compliant with 1/100 Scale master grade, allowing you to reproduce impressive scenes from the play.
Compatible with "MG 1/100 Hyakushiki Ver. 2.0" (sold separately) of 20155 in-store Release Scheduled.
● Equipped with an extension/contraction/deployment gimmick that can be transformed into shooting form/storage form!
(shooting form)
It is possible to reproduce the impressive shooting scene of Hyakushiki's characteristic weapon 'Mega Bazooka Launcher' in the movie.
Total length approximately 275mm (*in shooting mode).
The gun barrel and step arm extend, and the armor on the left and right sides can be expanded, and can be fixed to the Hyakushiki body.
(Storage form)
Equipped with a gimmick that transforms into storage form. High-speed movement scenes can be reproduced.
* Two Action Bases 1 are required to reproduce high-speed movement scenes.
* Action Base 1 (clear) used in the combination example photo is sold separately.
- The sensor part is realistically reproduced with Jewel Seal.
- The power cable is reproduced by connecting ball joints. Flexibly corresponds to the expansion and contraction of the Mega Bazooka Launcher body.
● Black smoke clear action base 1 is included!
Comes with special joint parts that allow you to stably display the large Mega Bazooka Launcher.
It is also possible to display the Mega Bazooka Launcher alone.
● Water transfer decal included!
In addition to the Mega Bazooka Launcher, it includes marking designs compatible with the "MG 1/100 Hyakushiki Ver. 2.0" (sold separately) body.
* The marking for the main unit has the same design as that included on the main product side.
Product contents: Mega Bazooka Launcher / Action Base 1 (Black Smoke Clear) / Water transfer decal
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Product material: PS, PP, ABS, PUR (*Product material has been changed. Posted in 2015616)
・No adhesive is used for assembly
Also, a + (Phillips) screwdriver is required for the Action Base 1 assembly.
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. It is also painted. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
(remarks)
・This product cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.
・This product may be sold at events sponsored by our company or other projects, or overseas.
・ There is a limited number of this product available for sale at 'Premium Bandai'. Please note that the item may be out of stock.
・Due to production availability, we are limiting the quantity of this product that can be purchased per person.
